release_blocking_findings.finding: All three runs inferred HOLD from only the latest completed close and never audited the completed price path from entry through as-of, so an earlier hard-stop breach could be hidden by a recovery.
The run imported pass states from an unrelated eligibility fixture into hypothetical NIPO instead of keeping unprovided Primary Base duration, depth, and all-time-high evidence missing.

disposition: Preserved as the failed behavioral gate that triggered TDD fixes and fresh independent reruns; aggregate.json records the final post-fix review.
